vulnerability.name: GO-2026-5932
vulnerability.description: golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp is unmaintained, unsafe by design, and has known security issues

statements.impact_statement: The advisory covers only the golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp packages. /usr/bin/caddy of the image is built from source by the Dockerfile (caddy/go.mod, caddy/go.sum), and the build fails if `go list -deps` of the Caddy main package lists any golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp package, so none of them is linked into the binary. Scanners that match by module version (govulncheck -mode=binary, Trivy, Grype) report it because the module golang.org/x/crypto is present for other packages.

zlib comes with the caddy:2-alpine base (Alpine 3.23), whose build with the fix (1.3.2-r1) is not published yet. The only process of the image is /usr/bin/caddy, a static Go binary built with CGO_ENABLED=0: it does not load libz (Go has its own compress packages). In the image libz is linked only by apk and curl, which neither the image nor the self-hosted package runs: the package executes only `caddy reload` and busybox `wget` in the caddy container. The finding goes away when the base image is republished with the fixed zlib; Dependabot then proposes the new digest.
